papers.title_en: A Short Review of Estimators for the GLM predictive of Laplace Bayesian Neural Networks
papers.evidence: 拉普拉斯近似贝叶斯神经网络预测估计的综述，涵盖KFAC和蒙特卡洛方法
papers.tldr: 贝叶斯神经网络预测分布估计因计算复杂度高而面临挑战。本文聚焦Laplace近似下的广义线性模型形式，系统综述了从精确GLM到蒙特卡洛近似的多种估计策略，包括Kronecker分解近似曲率等方法。揭示了不同方法在计算开销与统计效率间的权衡关系，为实际应用选择高效预测估计方案提供了统一理论指导。
papers.abstract_en: This short review examines the primary approaches for estimating the predictive distribution of Laplace-approximated Bayesian neural networks, with particular focus on the Generalized Linear Model (GLM) formulation. We survey the landscape of estimation strategies, from exact GLM computations requiring full Jacobian evaluations to Monte Carlo approximations that trade computational cost for statistical efficiency. The review covers the theoretical foundations of the Laplace approximation, the Kronecker-factored approximate curvature (KFAC) method for scalable posterior inference, and the various predictive estimation techniques developed in the literature. We provide a unified presentation that clarifies the relationships between methods and highlights their respective computational and statistical trade-offs.
